D: Clark Griswold tries to give his whole family the perfect old-fashioned Christmas.
P: Serve the turkey when Clark carves his and it collapses.
S: Clark and Eddie's eggnog in the moose-head mugs
Yolks whisked with sugar, hot milk and cream poured in, stirred over low heat to 75C, chilled overnight, finished with dark rum and fresh nutmeg grated over.
Jelly of the Month Club lime mould
the lime jelly Aunt Bethany gift-wraps

A retro lime jelly mould set with crushed pineapple and a creamy whipped layer, turned out wobbling onto a plate with fresh mint. Dissolve two 85g packets lime jelly in 500ml boiling water and stir in 300ml cold water and 1 tbsp lime juice. Pour half into a 1.2L mould and chill 1 hour until set. Chill the other half until thick but not set, then fold through 200ml whipped cream and a drained 440g tin crushed pineapple. Pour over and chill 4 hours. Dip the mould in hot water and turn out.
Eddie's RV parked out the front
Smoked kielbasa sliced thick on the diagonal, griddled until charred, tossed with onions cooked slowly in butter and a spoon of grainy mustard, on toothpicks.
M: the opposite of the one Clark carves
Turkey dry-brined 48 hours uncovered in the fridge, butter under the skin, roasted at 170C until the breast hits 65C, rested an hour under foil, carved at the table. Stuffing and gravy.
the big Griswold family Christmas spread

Leg ham scored in diamonds, studded with cloves and glazed with brown sugar, pineapple and mustard until sticky, with potato bake and peas. Remove the skin from a 3kg half leg ham, score and stud with cloves. Simmer 150g brown sugar, 200ml pineapple juice and 2 tbsp Dijon for 5 minutes. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, glazing every 15 minutes. Layer 1kg sliced potatoes with 300ml cream, 1 sliced onion and 100g cheddar and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Serve with 400g buttered peas.
W: Pecans toasted, then mixed with brown sugar, golden syrup, melted butter, eggs and vanilla, poured into a blind-baked case, baked at 170C for 50 minutes until just set.
K: Dark chocolate melted into hot full cream milk, whisked frothy, topped with marshmallows.

s.note: Clark and Eddie's eggnog in the moose-head mugs
s.how: Whisk 4 yolks with 80g sugar. Pour over 500ml hot milk and 200ml cream and stir over low heat to 75C. Chill overnight, then stir in 80ml dark rum and grate fresh nutmeg on top.

s.note: Eddie's RV parked out the front
s.how: Slice 500g kielbasa thick on the diagonal and griddle until charred. Cook 2 sliced onions slowly in 30g butter until soft. Toss together with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard and spear on toothpicks.

m.note: the opposite of the one Clark carves
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast roast with 1 tbsp sea salt flakes and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Push 50g soft butter and thyme under the skin and roast at 170C until it hits 65C inside, about 75 minutes. Rest 20 minutes under foil. Make 200g stuffing mix and a gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour and 375ml chicken stock.

w.how: Blind-bake a tin lined with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust. Whisk 3 eggs, 250ml golden syrup, 100g brown sugar, 60g melted butter and vanilla. Stir in 200g toasted pecans, pour in and bake at 170C for 50 minutes until just set.

d.how: Heat 1L full cream milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into four mugs and pile marshmallows on top. Drink it before the sled run.
